title: Charlotte | Boat Neck Sleeveless Top with Ribbed Detail
bodyHtml:
This sleeveless top is designed to flatter with effortless grace, thanks to a subtle ribbed texture that follows your curves without clinging. The boat neckline sits beautifully across the shoulders, while the sleeveless cut makes it perfect for warm days and layering. Soft to touch and light to wear, it's the kind of piece you'll reach for again and again—whether you're meeting friends for brunch or heading out for evening drinks.

Why you'll love it

  • Boat neckline that sits beautifully across the shoulders with understated elegance
  • Sleeveless and breathable, ideal for warm weather and year-round layering
  • Slim fit that skims your shape without clinging or pulling anywhere
  • Ribbed texture adds subtle depth and visual interest without fuss
  • Soft, fluid fabric that moves with you all day—no discomfort, no compromise
  • Versatile enough for jeans and sneakers by day, tailored trousers by night
  • A piece that's genuinely hard to find—designed for women who value quiet sophistication
